availability: Only forecast timestamps strictly before valid UTC day00 survive; origin is prior UTC day. All retained latest_issue timestamps independently asserted before cutoff.
aggregation: Latest available issue per cardinal point (demand) or UTC halfhour (wind), then mean/min/max or wind mean. These are forecast covariates, not realised daily targets.
not_a_scratch_forecast: This experiment imports NESO professional forecasts; report independently of self-built weather/history predictors.
imputation: Past forecast carried forward with missingness and age flags. Never interpolation from future.
important_limitation: UTC boundary excludes BST tail halfhours not yet published at origin; n is retained. Current archive has a long unavailable tail after2026-04-23 under this strict timestamp rule.
